evidence_level: recorded exact computation; per-polytope results, not a geometric replay
description: Height condition at the node parallelograms (Remark 3.27(2) of the paper) on the 364 hexagon-free polytopes of the list (Section 11.4) that satisfy (Proj). For each node parallelogram P in the two-face G = u^v cap u'^v and each of the two facets containing G (a pair), omega is the three-cell of the subdivision in that facet containing P, the height on that facet is e_{u'} = <u', .> + 1 (resp. e_u), and the height condition at the pair says that every lattice point of omega not in P (an apex of P) has height one. The largest height of an apex is attained at a vertex of omega. "sigma": the subdivision Sigma' of the boundary returned by the (Proj) linear program, with the number of violating pairs, the largest apex height, and the heights of the vertices of omega not in P, counted over all pairs ("vertex_heights"). "pulling": the refinement F_C of Sigma' obtained by pulling, in a fixed order, every boundary lattice point that is not a ray of Sigma'; recorded are the violating pairs, the largest apex height, that the cells of each facet fill it (normalised volumes), that every boundary lattice point is a vertex and no cell contains another lattice point, that the cells on the faces of dimension <= 2 are those of Sigma', and regularity (a height found by linear programming, rounded to rationals and re-checked exactly). "name" is the name used in results.json and "list_id" the id in forced_nodes/list_polytopes.json.gz.
